description: Create a scanner that registers a data source as catalog tables — the standard path for exposing Object Storage or Iceberg data (and Cloud DB / JDBC sources) as queryable tables. Creating a scanner does not scan: run it with ncloud_datacatalog_run_scanner (or set scheduleType=CRON). Use dryRun=true to preview without creating.

connectionId.description: Connection ID (see ncloud_datacatalog_get_connections). REQUIRED when type is a Cloud DB type or JDBC

databaseName.description: Output database name — where the scanned tables are created

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating the scanner

location.description: Scan path (e.g. 's3a://mybucket/test/'). REQUIRED when type is OBJECT_STORAGE or ICEBERG

maxTableThreshold.description: Maximum number of tables the scanner may create

opAddType.description: How to update an existing table when the source schema gains columns. ADD_NEW_COLUMNS_ONLY: add new columns only, UPDATE_TABLE: update the table definition, IGNORE_UPDATE: ignore

opDelType.description: How to update an existing table when source columns disappear. DEL_NO: ignore

scanFileLimitCnt.description: Scan only this many files, 1-100. Omit to scan everything. OBJECT_STORAGE only

schedule.description: Cron expression (e.g. '1 0 * * *'). REQUIRED when scheduleType is CRON

scheduleType.description: Run schedule. ON_DEMAND: only when requested, CRON: on a cron schedule (schedule is then required)

tablePrefixName.description: Prefix for the created table names

type.description: Data source type. OBJECT_STORAGE / ICEBERG require location; the Cloud DB types and JDBC require connectionId

name: ncloud_datacatalog_create_scanner
